items.source: Return a predicate to filter types.
items.translation: 返回一个用于过滤类型的谓词。

items.source: Return a predicate to filter fields.
items.translation: 返回一个用于过滤字段的谓词。

items.source: Return a predicate to filter methods for method signature introspection. not provided.
items.translation: 未提供用于方法签名内省以过滤方法的谓词。

items.source: BeanRegistrationAotProcessor implementations must be registered in a "META-INF/spring/aot.factories"<T> resource. This interface serves as SPI and can be provided through AotServices.
items.translation: `BeanRegistrationAotProcessor` 实现必须在 `"META-INF/spring/aot.factories"<T>` 资源中注册。该接口作为 SPI，可以通过 AotServices 提供。

items.source: TypeCollector discovers all implementations and applies the combined predicates returned by this interface to filter unwanted reachable types from AOT contribution.
items.translation: TypeCollector 发现所有实现，并应用此接口返回的组合谓词，以从 AOT 贡献中过滤掉不需要的可达类型。

items.source:
Strategy interface providing predicates to filter types, fields, and methods from being introspected and
contributed to AOT processing.
items.translation: 提供谓词以过滤类型、字段和方法，防止其被内省并贡献给 AOT 处理的策略接口。
